You can purchase medical training manikins and simulation equipment via the
WorldPoint Official Website
, though
the company does not manufacture consumer continuous glucose monitors or smartwatches
. Consumer health wearables that track glucose, ECG, and sleep are instead produced by brands like Apple, Garmin, and Dexcom.
Making Sense of Diabetes
Medical vs. Consumer Wearables
WorldPoint Products:
Focuses on CPR training manikins (such as CPR Taylor), AED trainers, and healthcare education tools rather than personal remote patient monitoring.
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Real medical grade sensors (like Dexcom or Abbott) apply a tiny filament under the skin to read interstitial glucose and can sync data to smartwatches.
Making Sense of Diabetes
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Devices featuring PPG and ECG sensors can spot heart rhythms like atrial fibrillation, but regulatory bodies caution that non-invasive wrist-based blood sugar readings lack official medical clearance.
